# React Integration

PatternFly 6's compatibility with React 19, Server Components, and React
Compiler. See [citations.md](../citations.md) for source details.

## React Version Support

`@patternfly/react-core` v6.4.1 declares peer dependencies [18]:
- React: `^17 || ^18 || ^19`
- React-DOM: `^17 || ^18 || ^19`

PatternFly supports the "2 most recent React versions" as policy [41].

### Comparison with Competitors

| Library | React Range |
|---------|-------------|
| Radix UI 2.1.16 | ^16.8 \|\| ^17.0 \|\| ^18.0 \|\| ^19.0 [22] |
| PatternFly 6.4.1 | ^17 \|\| ^18 \|\| ^19 [18] |
| MUI 7.3.9 | ^17.0.0 \|\| ^18.0.0 \|\| ^19.0.0 [19] |
| Ant Design 6.3.5 | >=18.0.0 [20] |
| Chakra UI 3.34.0 | >=18 [21] |

PatternFly's React 17+ range is broader than Ant Design and Chakra UI (React 18+),
matching MUI, and narrower than Radix (React 16.8+).

## React 19 Support

Full React 19 support shipped in **PatternFly 6.3 (July 2025)**: "PatternFly
now includes support for React 19 across all components and extensions" [4].

The React 19 migration initiative (pf-roadmap #201) had all 22 sub-issues
completed by Q2 2025 [41]. Support was added non-breakingly — React 17 and 18
continue to work [4][41].

## React Server Components (RSC)

**No evidence of RSC support found.** No documentation, roadmap items, or
`"use client"` directive mentions were discovered in any source.

Historical context: Issue #5756 (May 2021, closed as duplicate of #4035)
documented that compiled PatternFly React components do not include related CSS,
causing SSR framework issues [42].

## React Compiler

**No information found.** No documentation, testing results, or roadmap items
related to React Compiler compatibility were discovered.

## Next.js Compatibility

**Documented compatibility issues** (from GitHub issue #5756, May 2021) [42]:
- CSS import errors with SSR
- Severe performance degradation with workarounds: 4-minute compilation,
  40-60% CPU, 1-1.5GB RAM
- Required custom webpack configuration with `next-transpile-modules`

No evidence was found of updates to Next.js compatibility for Next.js 13+
App Router or React Server Components. The official demo app uses Create React
App, not Next.js [42].

A community `patternfly-nextjs-seed` project exists but its current status is
unknown [42].

## Gaps and Limitations

- RSC support status is inferred from absence of evidence — it may exist
  undocumented
- React Compiler compatibility is entirely unknown
- Next.js issue data is from 2021; the situation may have improved
- No `"use client"` directive analysis was performed on the PatternFly
  React source code
